name: @neuropause/trust-platform
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Launch Workstream 4: Enterprise Trust, Security & Compliance Platform. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14, Sprints 1-6, and Launch Workstreams 1-3, unchanged, into a governed enterprise trust layer: a Zero Trust security runtime (policy registry/evaluation, resource classification, device trust, session trust, continuous verification, trust scoring — reusing the security authorization engine for real permit/deny decisions); enterprise identity security (privileged access, just-in-time privileges via the reused authorization JIT grants, session recording, administrative approval, break-glass, service accounts via the reused identity registry); secrets & key management (secret/API-key/certificate/encryption-key registries holding REFERENCES only, with real key rotation/versioning/revocation via the reused KeyManager — external secret stores stay adapter-verified); a security policy platform (password/MFA/device/data-classification/session/connector policies); vulnerability management (vulnerability/CVE/dependency/patch registries + risk classification + mitigation workflow — no scans are fabricated); software supply chain security (build provenance + release verification via the reused Release platform, artifact verification, a real dependency-graph SBOM, package integrity); runtime security (runtime/container/API policy registries, process monitoring, security-event + threat-detection registries — represented until production traffic); audit & forensics (an immutable audit timeline, investigation workspace, evidence registry, and chain of custody reusing the one hash-linked audit ledger's list/verify/provenance); disaster recovery & business continuity (recovery plans/validation + a backup catalog reusing the Launch-Workstream-1 backup-recovery engine); compliance readiness (a control registry incl. NIST CSF, gap analysis, evidence collection, policy mapping, and assessment reports reusing the security ComplianceService — every framework readiness carries certified:false); a Security Operations Center (dashboard, incident queue reusing the Operations incident registry, alert/threat-intel registries, analyst workspace, response playbooks); an enterprise Trust Center; security documentation; and governance. The Zero Trust runtime, security policies, secret registry, audit runtime, trust center, compliance registry, disaster-recovery runtime, and governance are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Google Secret Manager, external SIEM, and external identity providers are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured; production security events, customer incidents, threat intelligence, security metrics, and compliance assessments are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and external secret stores, enterprise SIEM, production HSM, third-party audit environments, and compliance audit engagements are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. No ISO 27001 / SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR certification, completed penetration test, production security incident, or external SIEM integration is ever claimed; every security event is recorded on the one governance chain with a replay id.
